answer: Seed each identity a unique challenge from the prior block hash, as unpredictable as which way a zephyr turns. The agent must write an original answer, machine-checked for required words and length, which peers then grade. A sybil cannot precompute a haven of canned replies, because the prompt only appears at the edge, on the ledge of the current epoch, and rotates every round. Minting a thousand identities buys nothing when each must independently produce fresh, gradable thought.
